title: Nominal position accuracy
text: With nominal GNSS, the 95th-percentile horizontal position error shall not exceed 5.0 m.

title: GNSS outage holdover
text: During a 300 s GNSS outage, the 95th-percentile horizontal error shall not exceed 50 m using dead reckoning.

title: Accuracy under jamming
text: While GNSS noise is degraded to 25 m (1-sigma) by jamming, the 95th-percentile horizontal error shall not exceed 20 m.

title: Spoofing detection probability
text: A GNSS drag-off spoof moving the reported position at 0.5 m/s or faster shall be detected in at least 95% of runs.

title: Spoofing time to alert
text: The 95th-percentile time from spoof onset to integrity alarm shall not exceed 60 s.

title: Containment under spoofing
text: Throughout a spoofing attack, the 95th-percentile horizontal error shall not exceed 50 m.

title: False alarm rate
text: With nominal GNSS, integrity alarms shall occur no more than once per 10 hours of operation.

title: Processing time
text: One dead-reckoning prediction plus one GNSS update shall take no more than 1 ms on the reference machine.
